entries.title: Your iPhone and iPad show each change the moment you tap
entries.body: On your iPhone and iPad, closing a card, choosing on it or putting it aside now takes it off Home at once, and the next card is up. A message, a reply or a steer clears its box and shows marked Sending… until your computer has it, and Start and Interrupt read Starting and Stopping straight away. If your computer refuses a change, it goes back where it was, your words come back, and a short notice says why.
entries.noPicture: This changes when the iPhone and iPad app moves after a tap, which the desktop's hero pictures do not show.
